error.message: text must be a non-empty string

input.text: The editor must save changes automatically when the user navigates away.

tool.description: Suggest ontology predicate schemas for prose requirements before agents write facts. Retrieval/ranking is followed by a semantic applicability gate and conservative binding review; complete-looking generic placeholders never trigger application. Read-only guidance returns additive candidate diagnostics, an applicable predicate-fact plan only for a semantically eligible candidate with reviewed bindings, or an explicit ontology-gap observation plus a deterministic review-only predicate schema draft when no schema fits.

argumentBindings.description: Optional exact predicate argument values keyed by a candidate schema's argument_names. Required before applying a candidate whose binding_status is incomplete; Kibi never substitutes guessed values for unbound arguments.
argumentBindings.x-kibi-advertised-description: Optional exact predicate argument values keyed by argument name; required when binding_status is incomplete.

existingLogicClaims.description: Existing requirement logic_claims values. Returned relationship guidance includes a merged manifest so repeated clause modeling does not discard earlier claims.
existingLogicClaims.x-kibi-advertised-description: Existing requirement logic_claims values; the guidance merges the new claim key into them.

includeExistingSchemas.description: Whether to include existing KB fact_kind=predicate_schema facts alongside Kibi's built-in predicate catalog. Default: true.
includeExistingSchemas.x-kibi-advertised-description: Whether to include the KB's predicate_schema facts beside the built-in predicate catalog. Default: true.

maxCandidates.description: Maximum ranked predicate candidates to return. Default: 5.

minScore.description: Minimum candidate score. Higher values make ontology-gap fallback more likely. Default: 0.35.

polarityHint.description: Optional reviewed polarity override for claims whose surface negation does not express predicate denial. Use only after reviewing the selected schema and full claim scope.
polarityHint.x-kibi-advertised-description: Optional reviewed polarity override when surface negation does not mean predicate denial.

requirementId.description: Optional existing requirement ID. When provided, the response includes a relationshipPlan describing the req -> fact requires_predicate link to attach after preserving existing requirement metadata.
requirementId.x-kibi-advertised-description: Optional existing requirement ID; the response then plans its requires_predicate link.

schemaId.description: Optional exact reviewed predicate schema ID. When supplied, Kibi selects that schema instead of lexical rank order and fails closed if it is unavailable.
schemaId.x-kibi-advertised-description: Optional exact reviewed predicate schema ID to use instead of rank order; fails closed if unavailable.

source.description: Optional provenance or text reference for generated predicate facts or ontology-gap observations.

subjectHint.description: Optional canonical subject key to use as the first predicate argument. Example: 'editor.annotation'.

text.description: Required prose requirement or claim to classify into ontology predicates. Example: 'When users navigate away, draft edits must auto-save.'.
text.x-kibi-advertised-description: Required prose requirement or claim to classify into ontology predicates.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about, such as your git worktree, when it is not the server's.

tool.name: kb_suggest_predicates
